<h2>Build an sjSDM Unit Fitting Plan</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Validates preparation evidence for one analysis tier and classifies each
requested unit as eligible for fitting or expected infeasible.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_unit_fitting_plan(
  data_preparation_inventory = NULL,
  analysis_id = NULL,
  tier_id = NULL,
  scale_ids = NULL,
  resolution_ids = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_preparation_inventory">data_preparation_inventory</code></td>
<td>
<p>Data frame containing preparation evidence by analysis, tier, unit, and
resolution.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="analysis_id">analysis_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar identifying the analysis.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="tier_id">tier_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar identifying the spatial tier.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="scale_ids">scale_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Unique character vector of requested unit identifiers.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="resolution_ids">resolution_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Unique character vector of required resolutions.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Tibble with one row per requested unit and columns 'scale_id',
'fitting_status', and 'preparation_reason_code'.
</p>

</main>
